facts.ten-bundle: A man walks bent over, hugging ten wands in one armful.
facts.face-hidden: His face is buried in the bundle of wands and cannot be seen.
facts.toward-house: Far off on the right, a house with a red roof shows among the trees, and he heads toward it.
facts.bent-back: He walks with his back bent, pressed down by the weight.
facts.ground-sky: The background is yellow ground and blue sky.

glosses.face-hidden: The load hides his view, so he cannot see ahead well.
glosses.toward-house: The destination is near, but the load is too heavy.

reversedGloss.waning: Starting to put the load down one piece at a time and share it.
reversedGloss.excess: The load has passed the limit and is about to collapse.

misdescriptions.wrong: He carries the wands on his back.
He has arrived at the house.
